project_manifesto.title: Minimalist Architect Publication
project_manifesto.ethos: Signal over noise. Absolute digital minimalism. Form follows pure function.
project_manifesto.primary_objective: A structural space to publish technical essays and thoughts on software architecture and team dynamics. Zero marketing fluff.
project_manifesto.persona: Amir Mohammad Najafi (@njfamirm) - Senior Architect, minimalist, focuses on shipping value and calm technology.

design_and_css_architecture.layout_system: Bento Grid implemented via strict CSS Grid. MUST have a maximum width (e.g., max-w-screen-2xl or 1536px) and be centered on the screen.

spacing_and_borders.technique: Use a 1px gap system (e.g., grid-gap with a subtle background color) OR explicit 1px borders on elements to create a flawless wireframe look.
spacing_and_borders.padding: Consistent internal padding for all Bento boxes (e.g., p-6 or p-8).
spacing_and_borders.radius: No rounded corners (sharp edges) OR universally consistent slight rounding (e.g., rounded-xl). Pick one and stick to it strictly.

typography.sans_serif: Geist or Inter for UI and headings. Vazirmatn for Persian text.
typography.monospace: Monaspace or Fira Code for ALL metadata, dates, tags, and code blocks.
typography.hierarchy: Brutal scale. H1 should be massive and tightly tracked. Body text max-width: 65ch for optimal reading.

theme.mode: System-preference ONLY. Pure black (#000000) and pure white (#FFFFFF) base with neutral gray borders. NO manual theme toggle.

icons_and_visuals.system: Strictly technical, minimalist line icons only.
icons_and_visuals.stroke_width: Must be uniform across the entire site (e.g., exactly 1.5px stroke).
icons_and_visuals.library_preference: Lucide React or similar geometric line-art libraries.
icons_and_visuals.usage_rule: Use extremely sparingly. Typography and grid structure should do the heavy lifting. Never use icons as mere decoration.

interactions_and_animations.hover_states: Strictly 'Hard Invert' / Solid Fill. When hovering over clickable grid blocks or links, the background MUST instantly snap to a high-contrast color (pure inverted or the single accent color) and text color must invert. NO soft CSS transitions (use duration-0 or transition-none). It must feel binary, mechanical, and instant like a terminal.

grid_areas.name: Statement
grid_areas.content: Short, punchy architectural statement. Focus on shipping value, managing complexity, and the @njfamirm brand.

grid_areas.name: 3D_Canvas
grid_areas.instruction: HOLD EXECUTION. Output ONLY an empty container with id='canvas-container' and a placeholder border. DO NOT write WebGL or Three.js code until explicitly instructed.
grid_areas.future_behavior: Will contain a mouse-reactive undulating 3D object.

grid_areas.name: Writings_Feed
grid_areas.content: A raw, border-separated list of the 5 most recent articles. Title, description, and monospace date only.

grid_areas.name: Connect
grid_areas.content: Raw links using the @njfamirm identity (e.g., github.com/njfamirm, medium.com/@njfamirm). No icons, just monospace text links.

strict_negative_constraints: FATAL ERROR if you include a Search bar or search functionality.
FATAL ERROR if you include a Contact Form (use plain mailto link instead).
FATAL ERROR if you include a Newsletter signup.
FATAL ERROR if you include Pagination (just show latest logs).
FATAL ERROR if you include a 'Skills', 'Tech Stack', or 'Portfolio/Projects' section.
FATAL ERROR if you use drop-shadows, box-shadows, gradients, or blur effects.
FATAL ERROR if you write polite or fluffy placeholder text like 'Welcome to my website'. Use technical, raw placeholder copy.
FATAL ERROR if you use solid/filled icons, dual-tone icons, or multi-colored icons.
FATAL ERROR if icon stroke widths are inconsistent with each other or with the overall UI borders.
FATAL ERROR if hover effects use slow, soft fade transitions. They must be instant and harsh.
